entries.name: chat-sweep
entries.description: Reviews the monitored WhatsApp chats for pending items — unanswered questions, promised actions, approaching deadlines — and acts on the operator's behalf or flags decisions for approval.
entries.author: MelloB1989

entries.name: cold-scan
entries.description: Walks older WhatsApp chats the operator is no longer actively texting in and distils a durable per-chat summary into the chat-summary store the memory retrieval sub-agent reads.
entries.author: MelloB1989

entries.name: daily-post
entries.description: Reads your day — what you built, who you met, what you said, what memory knows — and, when the day was worth it, writes one post and publishes it to X and LinkedIn. Nothing is approved first, so it never names anyone: the host refuses any post containing a person, a client, an amount, a phone number or anything shaped like a credential, and enforces two posts a day at most.
entries.author: MelloB1989

entries.name: gchat-watch
entries.description: Watches the operator's Google Chat spaces for pending items and acts, flags or reminds — the Google Chat counterpart to chat-sweep.
entries.author: MelloB1989

entries.name: wa-monitor
entries.description: The proactive WhatsApp proxy. Reacts to incoming messages in monitored chats, answers what it confidently can in the operator's voice, and escalates anything that is a decision.
entries.author: MelloB1989
